figure.name: Nancy Drew
figure.breakdown: Fifty-four years of children's letters to a detective who did not exist, posted to an office that had chosen not to have a face - the woman who wrote most of the books was a house pseudonym, unnamed until 1991. The correspondence asked nothing of the far end, and a mailroom answered anyway.
figure.why_today: Today's edition: Somebody Wrote Back, set by “Lee Dong-yeon Denies Discarding Fan Letters, Unopened Envelope Found”. This figure is the record's case for it.

source.title: Lee Dong-yeon Denies Discarding Fan Letters, Unopened Envelope Found

figure.tell: Mildred Wirt Benson wrote 23 of the first 30 books under the Syndicate-chosen house pseudonym Carolyn Keene, and that pseudonym was not a person - it was a slot in a production system, reused across series by writers who never met.

persona.title: One death in Assam became a country thinking out loud
persona.why: A death in Assam where the public grief is still doing work a year on. A large public mourning that outlived the news cycle, which is the archive register at its most durable.

character.title: Virtue rewarded
character.why: Filed character/fictional-protagonist, on the shelf's test: "Is the figure available in more than one place at the same time, to people who have never met?" - and the second half of that test is what settles it, "if no author can override what the audience says they feel".

companion.title: The companion that talks back
companion.why: Optimised for attachment, available at four in the morning, with no floor on the other party's autonomy. The three clauses are the whole case: the design targets the feeling, the availability removes the friction, and the missing floor is what makes it unlike every earlier category.

divine.title: The icon answers nothing
divine.why: Filed divine/christ, on the shelf's own test: "Is the relationship expressed by being addressed rather than by being watched, and is the other end understood to hear?" The icon is not watched; it is venerated, kissed, carried in procession and censed.

institution.title: Forum culture
institution.why: Persistent text spaces with per-topic cultures and norms enforced by social pressure and volume. A body that governs itself, which is why it is institutional rather than a sub-culture.

cosmology.title: The cliffhanger
cosmology.why: End before the answer, fix the slot, leave the question open. The mechanism is the schedule, and the schedule is the thing the bond is actually made of - which is the claim continuity below then dismantles.

officer.title: The neighbour
officer.why: Someone whose kitchen light you can see, whose bin day you know, whose life you have tracked for years without ever having asked. Proximity without duty, which makes it the purest local case on the site.

predator.title: Fighting about a stranger in a reply section
predator.why: Fighting about a stranger in a reply section, in good faith. The object is a non-person who cannot be fought with, and the mechanism is the in-group. This is the cleanest instance of the register-as-category confusion the old taxonomy suffered from.
